items.title: Kennesaw State launches Georgia's first integrated Para sports program
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga.  – Kennesaw State University is launching Georgia's first integrated Para sports programs in athletics, creating new opportunities for elite Para student-athletes while advancing the University's commitment to excellence in athletics, education, and student success.

items.title: Owls Look to Keep Rolling, Head West to Sam Houston
items.summary: Kennesaw State football looks to keep momentum as they travel to Sam Houston on Saturday, Nov. 14 at 2 p.m.

items.title: Kennesaw State Athletics Provides Design Update on Wellstar Champions Complex
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics announced Wednesday that the schematic design phase has been completed for the Wellstar Champions Complex, the 55,000-square-foot future daily home for Kennesaw State football.
